cards.name: Sayōnaraden

boost.name: Irasshairaden
effect: Advance up to 3 spaces.
HIT: Retreat 1 space and gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
cards.description: 以Raden的招牌告別台詞「さようならでん」命名。打完就跑的hit-and-run戰術，命中後立刻後退並奪回節奏權，體現她優雅又狡猾的性格——就像她在直播中突然說再見然後光速下播一樣。

cards.name: Rakugo Vortex

boost.name: Storytelling
effect: Name a card type (Normal, Special, or Ultra). The opponent must discard one card of that type or reveal a hand without any.
HIT: The opponent must discard a card at random.
cards.description: 以她的落語家身份為靈感。透過精彩段子混淆對手心神，強制對手棄牌來破壞戰術佈局。Boost「講談」讓Raden能指定卡牌類型進行精準干擾，展現落語家掌控節奏的功力。

cards.name: Curator's Gaze

boost.name: Art Appraisal
effect: +0-1 Range and draw a card.
BEFORE: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Add one to your hand and discard the rest.
cards.description: 以她曾任學藝員（博物館策展人）的背景設計。透過專業眼光快速鑑定並篩選卡牌，調整手牌品質。高速度低威力，體現策展人觀察入微但不直接動手的特質。

cards.name: Maitake Fever

boost.name: Fungal Dance
effect: +2 Speed.
HIT: Push or Pull 1 or 2.
AFTER: The opponent must discard a card at random.
cards.description: 以她引爆話題的迷因歌曲《Maitake Dance》為核心。極高速度（9速）搭配棄牌效果，模擬那首洗腦歌讓人手忙腳亂的感覺。Boost「菌菇之舞」進一步提升速度，讓Raden像病毒般快速擴散攻勢。

cards.name: Sake Rush

boost.name: Bottomless Cup
effect: +2 Power and draw a card.
BEFORE: Close 2 spaces.
HIT: +2 Power if the opponent has more cards in hand than you.
cards.description: 以她的酒豪人設為靈感。近距離爆發型攻擊，強制拉近距離並在劣勢手牌時打出更高傷害。Boost「無底酒盃」越喝越勇，體現她豪爽飲酒後戰鬥力暴漲的形象。

cards.name: Contrast Elegance

boost.name: Culture Shock
effect: Stun Immunity and +3 Armor.
HIT: Push the opponent 3 spaces.
cards.description: 展現Raden高雅文化人與搞笑角的巨大反差。平常以防守為主強化裝甲，命中後將對手狠狠推開——就像她上一秒在聊博物館藏品，下一秒開始搞笑耍笨的巨大落差。

cards.name: Yatagarasu Dive

boost.name: Feather Step
effect: Move 1 or 2 spaces, then draw a card.
HIT: Pull the opponent up to 3 spaces and gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
cards.description: 以她的家紋「八咫烏」為意象。遠距離牽制技，從遠處發動攻擊並將對手拉近到自己的節奏中。Boost「鴉羽步」提供靈活移動和補牌，像烏鴉般敏捷而難以捉摸。

cards.name: Grandma's Wisdom

boost.name: Traditional Roots
effect: +3 Armor and opponents cannot Push or Pull you.
HIT: Regain 3 life.
AFTER: Draw a card.
cards.description: 以她由祖母帶大的成長背景為靈感。體現傳統教養賦予她的堅韌意志——不易被動搖（防推拉）、能自我恢復（回血），展現祖母傳承給她的生命力與智慧。

cards.name: Grand Exhibition

boost.name: Museum Tour
effect: Draw 3 cards. Add one to your Gauge.
BEFORE: Spend up to 6 Force for +1 Power per Force spent.
cards.description: 以她策劃展覽的經歷為概念。蓄力越久威力越強，可以投入最多6點Force來大幅強化傷害，體現策展人精密規劃、層層堆疊的策展哲學。Boost「博物館導覽」快速補牌並充能。

cards.name: 国宝級螺鈿 - Raden's Masterpiece

boost.name: Shell Inlay Art
effect: Spend up to 3 Gauge for +2 Power per Gauge spent.
HIT: The opponent discards cards at random until they have 3 cards in hand.
Ignore Armor. Ignore Guard.
cards.description: 終極王牌——以她的名字來源「螺鈿工藝」命名。無視一切防禦（穿甲穿盾），命中後大幅削減對手手牌。Boost「螺鈿細工」能追加投入Gauge來提升威力，如同真正的國寶級螺鈿工藝——華麗、精緻、一擊必殺。
